children: Parallel Loop, an enterprise artificial intelligence (AI) company, has raised USD 6.6 million in seed funding led by 3one4 Capital, with participation from Picus Capital, Flourish Ventures, Economic Development Innovations Singapore and other investors.

The round also saw participation from Paytm founder and chief executive Vijay Shekhar Sharma, CRED founder Kunal Shah and Philip Yeo, former chairman of Singapore’s Economic Development Board and A*STAR.

Founded in June 2026 by Prateek Jogani and Yujun Chean, Parallel Loop works with mid-market and large enterprises to integrate AI into existing technology systems, business processes and workflows. The company has teams in Singapore, Bengaluru, Bangkok, London and Dubai, and employs 30 people.
Parallel Loop serves more than 10 clients across industries and geographies, including Licious and Havells in India and Tokio Marine Safety Insurance in Thailand.

The company combines its AI technology stack with forward-deployed engineers who work alongside client teams to connect existing systems, develop AI-powered workflows and applications, and modernise legacy software. Its services include AI adoption planning, enterprise AI infrastructure and software development.

Its AI stack can be deployed within a client's cloud environment or on-premises, allowing businesses to set data residency requirements and use multiple AI model providers, including open-weight models.

Pramod, president and chief information officer at Havells India, said the company was using Parallel Loop for workflows, automation and dashboards. He added that the platform was also being used to support sales teams in their engagement with channel partners and influencers.

Before founding Parallel Loop, Jogani and Chean co-founded FairDee, a Thai insurtech company that was later acquired by Qoala. Jogani subsequently served as group chief technology officer at Qoala, while Chean served as group chief operating officer.
The founders said their experience working with businesses adopting AI informed their decision to establish Parallel Loop to help organisations integrate the technology into their operations.
